inspiration.observed_pattern: A SQLite block-store script builds recursive UNION ALL candidate sets and feeds a derived identifier subquery into DELETE cleanup statements.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Translate that cleanup shape into an independently authored stale-record purge: UNION ALL selects stale records from two partitions inside a double-derived subquery, and DELETE removes exactly those candidates.

fixture_notes: Only stale records from partitions 10 and 20 are deleted; a fresh record and a stale record from unrelated partition 30 remain.
determinism_notes: Fixed record IDs and partition values, explicit result ordering, and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE records (record_id INT PRIMARY KEY, partition_id INT NOT NULL, record_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, stale TINYINT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: DELETE FROM records WHERE record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM (SELECT record_id FROM records WHERE partition_id = 10 AND stale = 1 UNION ALL SELECT record_id FROM records WHERE partition_id = 20 AND stale = 1) AS stale_candidates)

checks.sql: SELECT record_id, partition_id, record_name, stale FROM records ORDER BY record_id
